usedFor: Evoliz holds invoices and clients and MailerLite holds the mailing list, so “New Client” runs “Create or Update Subscriber”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Client” in Evoliz, then “Create or Update Subscriber” in MailerLite
bestTemplate.why: “New Client” returns created or updated clients, and “Create or Update Subscriber” keeps repeats from doubling.

watchOut: “New Client” in Evoliz is polling over a recent time window, so a subscriber appears after a scheduled check.
